priorArtReview: Root actual ActorBake06 neutral portraits proved the beard morph defaults were repaired, but Root rejected the remaining hard rectangular moustache and jaw silhouette. This revision intentionally exports clean original faces without added beard surfaces. It retains the v7 derived-model clothed-leg body mask and sash clearance for actual Prototype03 garment penetration, plus the proven export basis. Root observed a gap above the child knee in ActorBake08 because its mask reached2cm below the hem. This revision retains skin2cm above the hem instead. Previous candidates and captures remain unchanged; fresh art and animated Unity inspection are required.
fbxBasisPolicy: One export-only rigid Rz(pi) basis on each common actor root targets Unity +Z; source preview -Y and actual bind/morph/skin data are restored and verified unchanged. Actual strict Unity +Z evidence is separate.
runtimeAnimation: No animation baked here. Root imports the separately licensed actual Quaternius locomotion donor as Humanoid and verifies retargeting in Unity.
imagePolicy: All referenced source PNGs remain byte-exact; no texture pixels are repainted or resaved.
scope: Real source-derived geometry/material/rig export. Blender previews are art inspection only, not Unity/browser gameplay or final quality approval.

developmentInstallation.scope: Byte-identical candidate installation for real engine integration and visual inspection. No release, Native or final art approval.
